title: People of God
definition: The People of God are those redeemed by God's mercy, set apart for His glory, and called to proclaim His excellencies.
summary: The People of God are those whom the Lord has called, redeemed, and claimed as His covenant possession.
christFocus: Jesus Christ forms a people for God's possession through His blood and resurrection.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine emphasizes belonging to God before belonging to any human institution. The Church is not self-created; it is a people formed by divine mercy and identified by God's name, Word, and promise. It connects the Church to the larger biblical story of God's covenant faithfulness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because Christians can treat the Church as a voluntary club or preference group. The people of God exist because the Lord chose, redeemed, and gathered them for Himself. That identity calls for holiness, loyalty, worship, and witness.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Remember that you belong to God before you belong to yourself. Let covenant identity shape your priorities and loyalties. Teach believers to see themselves as part of God's redeemed people, not isolated spiritual consumers.
